integrity: All claims supported by explicit gap classification and a standalone finite verifier; no external human audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classical cyclic BWT only, with 0<1, integer base at least three and substitution depth at least two; proof is exact, computation is finite corroboration. Stronger general morphism bounds establish order Theta(k), not the coefficient or ordered one-run spectrum. Prior-work coverage remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Exact Burrows–Wheeler run spectrum of generalized Cantor words
